items.question: Can I really use this without knowing how to code?
items.answer: Yes! ANYON is designed for non-technical founders. Through conversation with AI alone, it auto-generates all documents including PRD, UX/UI design, architecture, and ERD, then implements them in actual code. You can create professional-grade products with zero development knowledge.

items.question: Is it really free during the beta period?
items.answer: Yes, all features are completely free during the beta period. No hidden costs, no credit card required.

items.question: What if I get stuck?
items.answer: During the beta period, our dev team provides dedicated support. We'll help you directly when you're stuck, and half-price outsourcing is available if needed.

items.question: What types of apps can I build?
items.answer: You can build various products including web applications, mobile apps, SaaS products, e-commerce platforms, admin dashboards, and more. Built with modern stack (React, TypeScript, Node.js) and ready for production deployment.

items.question: Can I handle maintenance on my own?
items.answer: Yes! This is one of ANYON's biggest advantages. Just as you developed through conversation, you can modify and update through conversation. Bug fixes, new features, design changes - all possible through conversation alone.

items.question: What's the quality of generated code?
items.answer: Generates high-quality code following industry standards. Ensures type safety with TypeScript, uses modern React patterns, and features architecture considering security and performance. Generated code is fully customizable.

items.question: How does deployment work?
items.answer: Supports one-click deployment to major platforms like Vercel, Netlify, and AWS. Generated projects have standard structure, allowing free deployment to any hosting service of your choice.

items.question: How is data security handled?
items.answer: All data is encrypted and stored securely. Generated code and projects are completely user-owned and can be exported anytime. We comply with GDPR and major security standards.
